mapper.select: select ID, METRO_MEMBER_CARD_NUM, KEY_WRAP_VALUE1, KEY_STATUS, UPDATE_DATE, REG_DATE from METRO_MEMBER_STATIC_KEY where METRO_MEMBER_CARD_NUM = #{metroMemberCardNum} and KEY_STATUS = 1
select TO_CHAR(KEY_STATUS) as status, COUNT(1) as currentVersion, TO_CHAR(MAX(UPDATE_DATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as updateTime from METRO_MEMBER_STATIC_KEY group by KEY_STATUS order by KEY_STATUS
mapper.insert: merge into METRO_MEMBER_STATIC_KEY target using (select #{metroMemberCardNum} as METRO_MEMBER_CARD_NUM, #{keyWrapValue1} as KEY_WRAP_VALUE1 from dual) source on (target.METRO_MEMBER_CARD_NUM = source.METRO_MEMBER_CARD_NUM) when not matched then insert (ID, METRO_MEMBER_CARD_NUM, KEY_WRAP_VALUE1, KEY_STATUS, UPDATE_DATE, REG_DATE) values (SEQ_METRO_MEMBER_STATIC_KEY.nextval, source.METRO_MEMBER_CARD_NUM, source.KEY_WRAP_VALUE1, 1, systimestamp, systimestamp)
